title: Shift-invariant spaces on finite undirected graphs
summary: Shift-invariant spaces (SISs) on the real line provide a natural framework for representing, analyzing and processing signals with inherent shift-invariant structure. In this paper, we extend this framework to the finite undirected graph setting by introducing the concept of graph shift-invariant spaces (GSISs).
